```{r read-data}
sample_kills <- read.csv("./data/sample_kills_110800-112973.csv")
sample_rounds <- read.csv("./data/sample_rounds_110800-112973.csv")
historical_team_points <- read.csv("hltv_historical_rankings.csv")
```


## 1.1 Training and Testing Sets

We split the data by map rather than by individual round. This prevents rounds from the same map from appearing in both the training and testing sets.

```{r train-test-split}
data <- clean_data(sample_rounds,
                   sample_kills,
                   historical_team_points,
                   log_scale_equip_gap = FALSE,
                   log_scale_skill_gap = TRUE,
                   include_pistol = FALSE,
                   split = TRUE,
                   seed = 0318
                   )

train_data <- data$train_data
validate_data <- data$validate_data
test_data <- data$test_data
```

```{r models}
ls <- lm(team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data)
lr <- glm(team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data, family = "binomial")
rf <- ranger(team_1_win ~ map_name + team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data)
```


```{r}
lr_formula <- team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap

set.seed(27398)

# Bootstrap by sampling maps, not individual rounds
boot_coefs <- map_df(1:100, function(i) {
  print(i)

  rounds_boot <- train_data |>
    group_by(file_name) |>
    group_split() |>
    sample(
      size = n_distinct(train_data$file_name),
      replace = TRUE
    ) |>
    bind_rows()

  lr_all_boot <- glm(
    lr_formula,
    data = rounds_boot,
    family = "binomial"
  )

  enframe(
    lr_all_boot$coefficients,
    name = "variable",
    value = "coefficient"
  )
}, .id = "boot")

coefs_std <- boot_coefs |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(boot_sd = sd(coefficient)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(enframe(lr$coefficients,
                    name = "variable",
                    value = "coefficient") |>
                      mutate(theory_sd = summary(lr)$coef[,2]),
            by = "variable") |>
  mutate(standardized_coefficient = coefficient / boot_sd) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(standardized_coefficient))) |>
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)") |>
  select(variable, coefficient, boot_sd, theory_sd, standardized_coefficient)
print(coefs_std, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
pred_val_sample <- validate_data |>
  transmute(team_1_win = team_1_win,
            ls_predict = predict(ls, validate_data),
            ls_confidence = 2 * abs(ls_predict - 0.5),
            
            ls_predict_binary = if_else(ls_predict > 0.5, TRUE, FALSE),
            ls_correct = if_else(team_1_win == ls_predict_binary, TRUE, FALSE),
            lr_predict = predict(lr, validate_data, type = "response"),
            lr_confidence = 2 * abs(lr_predict - 0.5),
            lr_predict_binary = if_else(lr_predict > 0.5, TRUE, FALSE),
            lr_correct = if_else(team_1_win == lr_predict_binary, TRUE, FALSE),
            rf_predict_binary = predict(rf, validate_data)$predictions,
            rf_correct = if_else(team_1_win == rf_predict_binary, TRUE, FALSE)
            )

pred_val_sample

table(pred_val_sample$team_1_win, pred_val_sample$ls_predict_binary)
table(pred_val_sample$team_1_win, pred_val_sample$lr_predict_binary)
table(pred_val_sample$team_1_win, pred_val_sample$rf_predict_binary)
```

```{r}
calibration_results <- validate_data |>
  mutate(
    predicted = predict(lr, newdata = validate_data, type = "response"),
    actual = as.numeric(team_1_win),
    probability_group = ntile(predicted, 1000)
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_group) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    predicted_probability = mean(predicted),
    observed_probability = mean(actual),
    lower = binom.test(sum(actual), n())$conf.int[1],
    upper = binom.test(sum(actual), n())$conf.int[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration_results

ggplot(
  calibration_results,
  aes(x = predicted_probability, y = observed_probability)
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.01,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Calibration",
    x = "Predicted Win Probability",
    y = "Observed Win Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Stability Check
```{r}
data_options <- expand_grid(
  log_scale_equip_gap = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  log_scale_skill_gap = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  include_pistol = c(FALSE, TRUE)
) |>
  mutate(
    data = pmap(
      list(
        log_scale_equip_gap,
        log_scale_skill_gap,
        include_pistol
      ),
      \(equip, skill, pistol) {
        clean_data(
          sample_rounds,
          sample_kills,
          historical_team_points,
          equip,
          skill,
          pistol
        )
      }
    ),
    train_data = map(data, "train_data"),
    validate_data = map(data, "validate_data"),
    test_data = map(data, "test_data")
  )

data_options <- data_options |>
  mutate(
    results = purrr::pmap(
      list(
        train_data = data_options[["train_data"]],
        validate_data = data_options[["validate_data"]],
        test_data = data_options[["test_data"]]
      ),
      \(train_data, validate_data, test_data) {

        train_data <- train_data |>
          drop_na(team_1_win)

        validate_data <- validate_data |>
          drop_na(team_1_win)

        test_data <- test_data |>
          drop_na(team_1_win)

        # Linear regression
        ls <- lm(
          team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side +
            team_1_equip_gap +
            team_1_points_gap,
          data = train_data
        )

        # Logistic regression
        lr <- glm(
          team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side +
            team_1_equip_gap +
            team_1_points_gap,
          data = train_data,
          family = binomial()
        )

        # Random forest
        rf <- ranger(
          team_1_win ~ map_name +
            team_1_side +
            team_1_equip_gap +
            team_1_points_gap,
          data = train_data |>
            mutate(team_1_win = factor(
              team_1_win,
              levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)
            )),
          probability = TRUE,
          num.trees = 500,
          seed = 0318
        )

        # Validation predictions
        validate_predictions <- tibble(
          file_name = validate_data$file_name,
          file_id = validate_data$file_id,
          round_num = validate_data$round_num,
          actual = as.integer(validate_data$team_1_win),
          ls = predict(ls, newdata = validate_data),
          lr = predict(lr, newdata = validate_data, type = "response"),
          rf = predict(rf, data = validate_data)$predictions[, "TRUE"],
          set = "validate"
        )

        # Test predictions
        test_predictions <- tibble(
          file_name = test_data$file_name,
          file_id = test_data$file_id,
          round_num = test_data$round_num,
          actual = as.integer(test_data$team_1_win),
          ls = predict(ls, newdata = test_data),
          lr = predict(lr, newdata = test_data, type = "response"),
          rf = predict(rf, data = test_data)$predictions[, "TRUE"],
          set = "test"
        )

        # Combine predictions
        predictions <- bind_rows(
          validate_predictions,
          test_predictions
        ) |>
          pivot_longer(
            cols = c(ls, lr, rf),
            names_to = "method",
            values_to = "pred"
          ) |>
          mutate(
            pred_binary = as.integer(pred >= 0.5),
            pred_correct = pred_binary == actual
          )

        # Overall test metrics
        metrics <- predictions |>
          filter(set == "test") |>
          group_by(method) |>
          summarise(
            accuracy = mean(pred_correct) * 100,
            tp_rate = sum(pred_binary == 1 & actual == 1) /
              sum(actual == 1) * 100,
            tn_rate = sum(pred_binary == 0 & actual == 0) /
              sum(actual == 0) * 100,
            auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(actual, pred)) * 100,
            .groups = "drop"
          )

        list(
          metrics = metrics,
          predictions = predictions
        )
      }
    )
  ) 

data_options_predictions <- data_options |>
  transmute(
    log_scale_equip_gap,
    log_scale_skill_gap,
    include_pistol,
    predictions = map(results, "predictions")
  ) |>
  unnest(predictions)

data_options <- data_options |>
  mutate(
    results = map(results, "metrics")
  ) |>
  select(-train_data, -validate_data, -test_data) |>
  unnest(results)
```

```{r}
data_options_predictions <- data_options_predictions |>
  mutate(
    config = paste0(
      "E", as.integer(log_scale_equip_gap),
      "_S", as.integer(log_scale_skill_gap),
      "_P", as.integer(include_pistol)
    ),
    model = paste(method, config, sep = "_")
  )

# Validation predictions
ensemble_validation <- data_options_predictions |>
  filter(set == "validate") |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(file_name, file_id, round_num, actual),
    names_from = model,
    values_from = pred
  ) |>
  drop_na()

# Test predictions
ensemble_test <- data_options_predictions |>
  filter(set == "test") |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(file_name, file_id, round_num, actual),
    names_from = model,
    values_from = pred
  ) |>
  drop_na()

# Model names
model_names <- sort(unique(data_options_predictions$model))

# Validation data
x_validate <- data.matrix(
  ensemble_validation |> select(all_of(model_names))
)

y_validate <- ensemble_validation$actual

# Optimize ensemble weights
library(CVXR)

weights <- Variable(length(model_names))

objective <- Minimize(
  sum_squares(x_validate %*% weights - y_validate) /
    nrow(x_validate)
)

constraints <- list(
  weights >= 0,
  sum(weights) == 1
)

problem <- Problem(objective, constraints)
solution <- solve(problem)

fitted_weights <- as.numeric(CVXR::value(weights))

# Save weights
ensemble_weights <- tibble(
  model = model_names,
  weight = fitted_weights
)

# Test predictions
x_test <- data.matrix(
  ensemble_test |> select(all_of(model_names))
)

ensemble_predictions <- ensemble_test |>
  transmute(
    file_name,
    file_id,
    round_num,
    actual,
    pred = as.vector(x_test %*% fitted_weights),
    pred_binary = as.integer(pred >= 0.5),
    pred_correct = pred_binary == actual
  )
```

# Using the final chosen model

```{r true-data}
data <- clean_data(sample_rounds,
                   sample_kills,
                   historical_team_points,
                   log_scale_equip_gap = TRUE,
                   log_scale_skill_gap = TRUE,
                   include_pistol = TRUE,
                   split = TRUE,
                   seed = 0318
                   )

train_data <- data$train_data
validate_data <- data$validate_data
test_data <- data$test_data

lr <- glm(team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data, family = "binomial")
```

```{r}
validate_predictions <- predict(
  lr,
  newdata = validate_data,
  type = "response"
)

thresholds <- sort(unique(c(0, validate_predictions, 1)))

threshold_results <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, \(cutoff) {
  pred <- as.integer(validate_predictions >= cutoff)
  actual <- validate_data$team_1_win

  sensitivity <- sum(pred == 1 & actual == 1) / sum(actual == 1)
  specificity <- sum(pred == 0 & actual == 0) / sum(actual == 0)

  tibble(
    cutoff = cutoff,
    sensitivity = sensitivity,
    specificity = specificity,
    balanced_accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
  )
})

best_cutoff <- threshold_results |>
  slice_max(balanced_accuracy, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

best_cutoff

threshold_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sensitivity, specificity, balanced_accuracy),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(cutoff, value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = best_cutoff$cutoff,
    linetype = "dashed"
  )
```
0.525 is the cutoff

```{r}
validate_results <- validate_data |>
  mutate(
    pred = predict(lr, newdata = validate_data, type = "response")
  )

target_probability <- 0.40

similar_rounds <- validate_results |>
  arrange(abs(pred - target_probability)) |>
  slice_head(n = 100)

set.seed(0318)

B <- 2000

bootstrap_results <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(B), \(i) {
  similar_rounds |>
    slice_sample(n = nrow(similar_rounds), replace = TRUE) |>
    summarise(win_rate = mean(team_1_win)) |>
    pull(win_rate)
})

quantile(bootstrap_results, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
```

```{r}
target_probabilities <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.001)

calibration_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
    target_probabilities,
    \(target) {
        
        similar_rounds <- validate_results |>
            arrange(abs(pred - target)) |>
            slice_head(n = 100)
        
        tibble(
            target = target,
            observed = mean(similar_rounds$team_1_win)
        )
    }
)

calibration_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = target, y = observed)) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted win probability",
    y = "Observed win rate",
    title = "Logistic regression calibration",
    subtitle = "100 nearest validation rounds per probability"
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(0318)

target_probabilities <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05)

bootstrap_lookup <- purrr::map_dfr(
  target_probabilities,
  \(target) {

    similar_rounds <- validate_results |>
      arrange(abs(pred - target)) |>
      slice_head(n = 100)

    bootstrap_results <- purrr::map_dbl(
      seq_len(2000),
      \(i) {
        similar_rounds |>
          slice_sample(n = nrow(similar_rounds), replace = TRUE) |>
          summarise(win_rate = mean(team_1_win)) |>
          pull(win_rate)
      }
    )

    tibble(
      target = target,
      n = nrow(similar_rounds),
      observed = mean(similar_rounds$team_1_win),
      lower = quantile(bootstrap_results, 0.025),
      median = quantile(bootstrap_results, 0.50),
      upper = quantile(bootstrap_results, 0.975)
    )
  }
)
```

Maximum spending for CT: 44,000.
Maximum spending for T: 41,500.
